title: Greece – Pipes and fittings – ΠΡΟΜΗΘΕΙΑ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΔΡΕΥΣΗΣ - ΑΡΔΕΥΣΗΣ
description: Ο Δήμος Νέας Προποντίδας διαχειρίζεται ένα τεράστιο δίκτυο υδρευτικό και αρδευτικό. Φυσικά οι φθορές και οι βλάβες είναι πάρα πολλές και προκειμένου να ανταποκριθούμε στην αποκατάσταση τους απαιτούνται υλικά. Επίσης τα τελευταία χρόνια η ανάγκη αυτή κατέστη άμεση και επιτακτική λόγω γεγονότων απρόβλεπτων αλλά και λόγω λειψυδρίας, σε όλη τη διάρκεια του έτους και κυρίως κατά τη θερινή περίοδο. CPV: 44163000-0 Σωληνώσεις και εξαρτήματα H Πολιτεία αναγνωρίζοντας τη δυσμενή κατάσταση στην οποία είχε περιέλθει ο Δήμος μας λόγω παρατεταμένης ανομβρίας, με την υπ. αρ. πρωτ. Α3515/27-8-2024 απόφαση της Γενικής Γραμματείας Πολιτικής Προστασίας, κήρυξε τον Δήμο Νέας Προποντίδας σε κατάσταση Έκτακτης Ανάγκης Πολιτικής Προστασίας, για την διαχείριση των συνεπειών που ενδέχεται να προκύψουν από την εκδήλωση φαινομένων λειψυδρίας στον Δήμο, ενώ με την υπ. αρ. πρωτ. Α3366/24-07-2025 απόφαση, παρατάθηκε η χρονική διάρκεια ισχύος της κήρυξης Έκτακτης Ανάγκης Πολιτικής Προστασίας, η οποία σήμερα έχει λήξει αλλά οι συνέπειες παραμένουν. Για να μπορέσουμε να αντιμετωπίσουμε την δυσμενή αυτή κατάσταση λειψυδρίας, απαιτείται μεταξύ άλλων παρεμβάσεων και η αντικατάσταση των πεπαλαιωμένων δικτύων ύδρευσης, όπου τα δίκτυα αδυνατούν να ανταποκριθούν και να εξυπηρετήσουν τον πληθυσμό, με αποτέλεσμα να σημειώνονται συχνά βλάβες, που συνοδεύονται με διακοπή της υδροδότησης. Χαρακτηριστικά ήταν τα παραδείγματα και της περυσινής καλοκαιρινής περιόδου, όπου οικισμοί έμειναν για πολλές ώρες χωρίς νερό. Επίσης, η αντικατάσταση των πεπαλαιωμένων υλικών δικτύων ύδρευσης, θα συμβάλλει στην μείωση των διαρροών και κατά συνέπεια στην εξασφάλιση της ποσοτικής επάρκειας και της ποιοτικής βελτίωσης του διανεμόμενου ύδατος. Η εκτιμώμενη αξία της σύμβασης ανέρχεται στο ποσό των 658.145,45 € συμπεριλαμβανομένου του Φ.Π.Α. (Προϋπολογισμός χωρίς Φ.Π.Α. 530.762,46 € & ο Φ.Π.Α. 127/382,99 €). Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στην επισυναπτόμενη μελέτη της παρούσας διακήρυξης. Οι ποσότητες της μελέτης είναι ενδεικτικές. Επιτρέπεται η τροποποίηση των ποσοτήτων μεταξύ των γραμμών της σύμβασης. Μπορούν τροποποιούνται οι ποσότητες με είδη που περιλαμβάνονται στη σύμβαση και με την τιμή προσφοράς που έδωσε ο ανάδοχος σε κάθε είδος. Η τροποποίηση αυτή καθίσταται μη ουσιώδεις αφού δεν αλλάζει την οικονομική ισορροπία της σύμβασης (άρθρο 132 παρ. 1ε), καθώς απαραίτητη προϋπόθεση είναι ότι οι αλλαγές αυτές θα κυμαίνονται μέχρι τα όρια του ποσού της σύμβασης Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με κριτήριο ανάθεσης την πλέον συμφέρουσα από οικονομική άποψη προσφορά βάσει τιμής. Προσφορές υποβάλλονται για το σύνολο του συμβατικού αντικειμένου. Η παρούσα σύμβαση δεν υποδιαιρείται σε τμήματα και ανατίθεται ως ενιαίο σύνολο, διότι το φυσικό αντικείμενο είναι ενιαίο και αδιαίρετο για να είναι δυνατή άμεσα η λειτουργία των προς προμήθεια. Η διάρκεια της σύμβασης θα είναι για δύο έτη από την υπογραφής της σύμβασης, ή μέχρι εξάντλησης του προϋπολογισμού

title: RFI Plum Island Animal Disease Center (PIADC) Closure & Support (PICS) for the Program Management Office (PMO)
description: This Request for Information (RFI) supports the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Science and Technology (S&T) Directorate�s efforts to conduct market research in support of the Plum Island Animal Disease Center (PIADC) Closure & Support (PICS) for the Program Management Office (PMO). The S&T Directorate has responsibility for the safe, reliable, secure, efficient and compliant operations of PIADC, which is located on Plum Island, New York, an 840-acre island located approximately one and one-half miles from the eastern end of Long Island�s North Fork. DHS is seeking an Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Contractor to manage, operate, and maintain facilities, equipment, systems and grounds as PIADC implements a multi-year mission to decommission the island and its associated assets. For over 70 years the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) performed animal research, diagnostics and training at PIADC to protect our nation�s food supply from foreign animal diseases. Today, the mission at PIADC is shifting from only limited diagnostic support to a full closure mission managed under the DHS Plum Island Closure Support (PICS) Program. As part of PIADC�s mission transition, the USDA Agricultural Research Service (ARS) completed their research mission at PIADC in 2025 and the USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) will complete their mission in October 2026, with an anticipated short follow-on presence to remove all personnel, biological agents and assets ending in March 2027. The PICS program will require the continuation of O&M support services at PIADC, with the exception of scope that was necessary to support science and research performed by USDA. The Excerpted Statement of Work (ESOW) provides an outline of scope that is required to operate and maintain PIADC starting in January 2027, with a summary description of areas that must remain functional throughout the closure period, which is expected to end between 2031 and 2034. DHS PIADC invites all businesses to submit a written response that includes a self-assessment of your capabilities to fulfill the tasks outlined in the ESOW. If your organization cannot fulfill all identified tasks independently, please describe any proposed teaming arrangements that would enable you to meet the Government�s full requirements. The scope of services is defined in the ESOW. Please refer to the ESOW for comprehensive details regarding required operations, maintenance, and closure support activities. The ESOW is available upon request from the Contract Specialist and Contracting Officer. Please email both points of contact to request the ESOW.

title: Mouse Digital Ventilated Cage (DVC) Individually Ventilated Rack System � Pilot Expansion and Software License
description: NOI-PCA-ORS-26-09461 NAICS � NAICS � 513210 / $47M � SOFTWARE PUBLISHERS THIS IS A NOTICE OF INTENT AND NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTATIONS. The Division of Veterinary Resources (DVR), within the Office of Research Services (ORS), National Institutes of Health (NIH), intends to negotiate on an other than full and open competition basis with Tecniplast Group, USA, P.O. Box 1209, West Chester, PA 19380. This requirement requires the procurement, delivery, installation, commissioning, and training associated with an expansion of its existing Tecniplast Digital Ventilated Cage (DVC) individually ventilated caging (IVC) rack system for mice at NIH facilities located in Bethesda, Maryland. DVR currently operates a Tecniplast DVC demonstration/pilot rack system, and this acquisition will procure additional Tecniplast DVC-compatible racks, cages, air handling units, software licensing, and related components necessary to expand housing capacity while maintaining full technical and data compatibility with the existing installed system. Continuous access to a single, compatible ventilated caging and automated monitoring platform is critical to maintaining animal welfare, biocontainment integrity, data continuity, and compliance with federal regulations governing laboratory animal care. DVR previously installed a Tecniplast DVC demonstration rack system at its Bethesda, Maryland facility to evaluate individually ventilated caging performance and automated, non-invasive home-cage monitoring capability, including artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML)-enabled analysis of animal activity and welfare indicators. DVR now requires an expansion of that system to increase mouse housing capacity while preserving compatibility with the already-installed racks, cages, air handling units, control infrastructure, and DVC software platform. This acquisition supports the initial expansion phase of DVR's broader Mouse Housing Infrastructure Modernization program. Separately, DVR's Market Research Report and Acquisition Plan for the enterprise-wide replacement of DVR's approximately 15,000-cage mouse housing census recommend full and open competition using vendor-neutral, performance-based specifications, because multiple manufacturers can meet DVR's general IVC rack requirements. This action is distinct from, and does not substitute for, that future full and open competitive acquisition. This action is limited to the expansion of the existing Tecniplast DVC pilot installation, for which Tecniplast is the only source capable of providing hardware and software that is technically and operationally compatible with the equipment DVR has already installed and is currently using to collect longitudinal animal welfare monitoring data. All products provided under this contract must support compliance with the Animal Welfare Act (AWA), Public Health Service Policy on Humane Care and Use of Laboratory Animals, the Guide for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals, AAALAC International accreditation standards, and Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) requirements. 3. title: B--WV-ESFO-BUMBLE BEE STUDY
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD SOLE SOURCE FOR FWS WV ESFO for Rusty Patch Bumble Bee Study TO Environmental Solutions & Innovations, Inc. THIS IS A NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT AND IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES. U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Joint Administrative Operations, Acquisition & Property Operations intends to award a firm fixed price sole source contract under the authority of: FAR 6.302-1 only one responsible source To Environmental Solutions & Innovations, Inc. 4525 ESTE AVE CINCINNATI, OH 45232-1762 The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this requirement is 541620 Environmental Consulting Services $16.50 Million. The object of this sole source award to Environmental Solutions & Innovations, Inc is for The rusty patched bumble bee was listed as an endangered species in 2017 due to an estimated 90% reduction in their historic range. Bumblebee (Hymenoptera: Apidae) conservation requires knowledge of nesting densities, but this aspect of their life history is poorly understood. The MN-WI Field Office (MN-WI FO) of USFWS secured funding to contract with the The Koch Biodiversity Conservation Laboratory to perform genotyping of bumble bees using DNA samples to reconstruct full-sibling relationships and estimate nest abundance with genetic capture-recapture models. The genetic data will also contribute data towards population health monitoring; genetic health of populations is a metric used to track progress towards long-term RPBB recovery goals. This specific project will support the fieldwork to locate and capture bumble bees, then collect non-lethal tarsal clip samples throughout the field season in 2027. Sampling will occur across the varying habitats used by the species in Appalachians, and will include samples from the American bumble bee (AMBB, B. pensylvanicus) to support a landscape-scale genetics study to estimate the nesting density of these two ecologically dissimilar species. Non-lethal DNA samples will also be collected from the common Eastern bumble bee (CEBB, B. impatiens), a widespread and common species found in the U.S. Samples will be collected in the eastern, high elevation forests of West Virginia and Virginia. This information will provide more accurate estimates of nest densities than those currently used in USFWS Section 7(a)(2) consultations under the Endangered Species Act (ESA), which are largely based off a closely related European species, B. terrestris (USFWS 2025). This synopsis does not constitute a solicitation; however, if any interested party believes they can meet the above requirement, it may submit a statement of capabilities. The statement of capabilities must be submitted in writing and must contain clear and convincing evidence that competition of this requirement would be advantageous to the Government. If parties choose to respond, any cost associated with preparation and submission of data or any other cost incurred in response to this announcement are the sole responsibility of the respondent and will not be reimbursed by the Government. Capability statements shall be submitted by e-mail ONLY as a Microsoft Word or Adobe PDF attachment to the following address: keith_rose@ios.doi.gov

title: Germany – Health and safety services – Institut für Hygiene und Umwelt (HU) der FHH - Leistungen nach der Baustellenverordnung Sicherheits- und Gesundheitskoordinator (SiGeKo)
description: Für das Institut für Hygiene und Umwelt (HU) und Hamburg Wasser soll ein neues Labor- und Institutsgebäude errichtet werden. Ziel ist ein Büro- und Verwaltungsneubau, der den aktuellen Anforderungen moderner Laborgebäude entspricht und einen möglichst reibungs-losen sowie effizienten Betriebsablauf gewährleistet. Das Vorhaben umfasst die Nutzung als Labor- und Bürogebäude mit einer Gesamtnutzungsfläche von ca. 24.500 m2 (NUF) bzw. ca. 49.585 m2 Bruttogrundfläche (BGF) oberirdisch. Errichtet werden soll es in Ham-burg-Mitte auf dem Grundstück Bullenhuser Damm/ Großmannstraße, auf ca. 12.000 m2 Fläche. Die Arbeitsschwerpunkte des Instituts für Hygiene und Umwelt (ca. 300 Mitarbeitende) liegen in Lebensmittelsicherheit und Zoonosen, Hygiene und Infektionsmedizin so-wie Umweltuntersuchungen, ergänzt durch die Abteilung Service und Steuerung. Die vor-gesehene Nutzung macht eine räumliche Gliederung der einzelnen Funktionsbereiche in öffentliche und nichtöffentlich zugängliche Bereiche erforderlich, die sich wie folgt unterteilen: Der öffentliche Bereich des Gebäudes umfasst u.a. eine Impfstelle, einen Hörsaal, ein Kurslabor, das HU-Museum, eine Kantine, eine Poststelle, Bereiche für Konferenzen sowie einen Empfangs- und Foyerbereich. Den Kern des nicht öffentlichen Bereichs des Gebäu-des bilden 4 Laborbereiche für Hamburg Wasser und 25 Laborräume der Fachbereiche HU mit u.a. einer zentralen Probenannahme, zentrale Chemikalien- und Verbrauchsmittellager, S2-/S3-Labore, Sektionsbereiche, Sensorikbereiche, einer Kastenförderanlage, Autoklavenräume sowie der Verwaltungstrakt. Die Außenflächen sind ebenfalls in öffentliche Bereiche (Besucher, Patienten, Anlieferung und ggf. Mitarbeiterparkplätze etc.) und nicht öffentliche Bereiche (Wirtschaftshof, Sektionsbereich, Parkplatz für Dienstfahrzeuge, etc.) getrennt. Für den Stadtraum Billebecken – zwischen Bille, Billekanal und Ausschläger Bill-deich – wird derzeit ein städtebaulicher Funktionsplan abgestimmt und erstellt. Das Bau-vorhaben soll sich planerisch möglichst gut in dieses Funktionsplankonzept einordnen. Die Gestaltung der Freiflächen, öffentlich einsehbarer und halböffentlich nutzbarer Flächen sowie die Anliefersituation sind während des Planungsprozesses mit der Angeberin BEBEG (Billebogen Entwicklungsgesellschaft mbH & Co. KG) und den genehmigenden Behörden abzustimmen. Aufgrund der unterschiedlichen Nutzungsbausteine und komplexen Funktionsanforderungen wird der Planungs- und Entwurfsprozess sowie die Umsetzung und der Betrieb der Gebäude durch Building Information Modeling (BIM) 3D-basierte Modellierungsmethoden unterstützt. Zur Steuerung der Gesamtprozesse im Projekt kommen kooperative Arbeitsmethoden/Lean Management zum Einsatz. Die Leistungen werden stufenweise beauftragt. Die Beauftragung erfolgt dabei in 2 Stufen, wobei sich die einzelnen Leistungen wie folgt auf die Stufen aufteilen: Stufe 1 beinhaltet die Leistungen nach § 3 Abs. 2 BaustellV LP 3- LP 7 Stufe 2 beinhaltet die Leistungen nach § 3 Abs. 3 BaustellV LP 8 Besondere Leistungen aus der Erläuterung des Leistungsbilds gem. AHO-Heft Nr. 15 Siehe Anlage 7 Leistungsverzeichnis Angebot Mit dem Zuschlag wird die Stufe 1 beauftragt. Die Beauftragung der weiteren Leistungsphasen erfolgt stufenweise und optional. Ein Anspruch auf die Beauftragung weiterer Stufen besteht nicht.

title: Germany – Theatre construction work – Bühnenausstattung
description: Beschreibung der Leistung: Die Spiel- und Veranstaltungsstätte Kampnagel soll modernisiert und erweitert werden. Derzeit sind bereits zwei Gebäudekörper vorhanden, die Hallen haben bis zu zwei Obergeschosse mit einer BGF von 15.673 m². In diesen befinden sich sechs zu sanierende Veranstaltungshallen sowie Probebühnen und Studios. Die K7 ist als Neubau oberhalb der Hallen mit einer BGF von 7.606 m² geplant und beinhaltet weitere auszustattende Probühnen und Studios sowie Lager- und Werkstattflächen. Im bestehenden Verwaltungsgebäude finden ebenso wie im neuen Residenzgebäude keine veranstaltungstechnischen Maßnahmen statt. Das Leistungsverzeichnis Obermaschinerie (OM) umfasst die vollständige, betriebsfertige Planung, Lieferung, Montage, Verkabelung, Inbetriebnahme und Dokumentation der maschinentechnischen Anlagen der Obermaschinerie für die Hallen- und Foyerbereiche der Bauteile Nord (B01n) und Süd (B01s). title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Extremely Low Resource Optical Identifier (ELROI)
description: Engineers at Los Alamos National Laboratory have developed a �license plate� for satellites to help solve the growing problem of space traffic management. The Extremely Low-Resource Optical Identifier (ELROI) is a simple, easy-to-fly, solar-powered beacon that can be attached to a satellite for tracking. Each ELROI unit transmits a custom identification number that can be read from the ground using signal processing techniques also developed at Los Alamos. The Challenge: Identifying space objects after launch remains a persistent challenge. When dozens of satellites are deployed simultaneously, determining which object is which using traditional radar or optical tracking methods is slow, error-prone, or sometimes impossible. This lack of real-time, reliable identification hinders satellite commissioning, increases operational risk, and undermines space traffic management efforts. Unidentified satellites are particularly problematic after their radio systems are disabled or fail. Without continuous, verifiable identification, defunct satellites add uncertainty to orbital catalogs and increase the risk of collision. Problems Solved: ELROI solves the space object identification problem by providing an autonomous, low-cost, optical beacon that broadcasts a unique ID from orbit. ELROI: enables definitive post-launch identification of satellites faster than conventional means; operates without RF emissions, making it ideal for use even after satellite deactivation; functions autonomously, activating and broadcasting without requiring power or communication from the host spacecraft; and continues operation even after satellite passivation, offering a persistent identity signal over the object�s orbital lifetime. In 2024�25, ELROI was demonstrated successfully on LaCE-1 and R5-S4 satellites, providing the first definitive identification for each satellite in orbit ahead of operator or catalog resolution. Key Advantages Ultra-Low SWaP-C (Size, Weight, Power, and Cost): Final designs aim for just a few grams and a few cubic centimeters, requiring minimal power. No RF Interference: Uses optical rather than radio frequency, sidestepping spectrum crowding and regulatory issues. Autonomous and Passive: No spacecraft support required; beacon runs independently, even on dead satellites. Fast and Robust Identification: High-confidence decoding of unique identifiers using ground-based photon counting techniques, even with low signal strength. Scalable and Flexible: Can be added to any space object, including CubeSats and deployable debris, without complex integration. Resilient Design: Uses robust encoding schemes (e.g., BCH error-correcting codes) to ensure ID recovery under high noise and low signal conditions. Next Steps For ELROI to become a standard part of space operations, three parallel tracks must advance: Beacon Manufacturing: Move from prototypes to production-scale manufacturing of standardized, miniaturized ELROI units. Ground Network Expansion: Establish a distributed network of ground stations using cost-effective photon-counting or hybrid imaging systems. Operator Adoption: Encourage satellite operators to integrate ELROI through demonstrated benefits, policy incentives, and regulatory encouragement. Widespread use will grow as ELROI proves its value, stays low-cost, and gains support for improving space safety. Market Applications: Space Traffic Management: A standard beacon on all space objects reduces uncertainty, supports catalog maintenance, and improves deconfliction. Regulatory Compliance: Enables better enforcement of norms and international transparency for satellite tracking and ownership. Mission Assurance: Helps satellite operators confirm identity quickly after deployment, expediting commissioning and reducing risk. End-of-Life Management: Provides lasting identity for passivated or tumbling satellites, supporting sustainable space practices. Commercial Launch Services: Can be included as standard hardware on launch platforms to simplify post-launch operations for clients. Development Status: TRL 8 US Patent No. 11,750,677 (S133647.002); 12,101,366 (S133647.003); 12,101,367 (S133647.004); Pending S133830 LA-UR-25-27913 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. LANL�s licensing program focuses on moving inventions developed by our researchers to commercial innovations. Patented and patent pending inventions and copyrighted software are available to existing and start-up companies through exclusive and non-exclusive licensing agreements. For specific discussions, please contact licensing@lanl.gov. title: Finland – Health and social work services – Lastensuojelun ympärivuorokautiset palvelut
description: Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialue pyytää tarjouksia Lastensuojelun ympärivuorokautiset palvelut -hankinnassa. Palvelun tilaajana on Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialue. Tilaaja järjestää hankinnan kohteena olevia palveluja sekä omana toimintanaan että ostopalveluina. Hankintamäärät voivat muuttua asiakkaiden tarpeiden, palvelun järjestämistapojen tai niiden painopisteiden muuttuessa. Mahdollinen palvelu- ja hyvinvointialueiden rakenteiden muutos voi vaikuttaa sekä tarvittavan palvelun määrään, että hankittavien palveluiden sisältöön. Hankinnan kohteena on Lastensuojelun ympärivuorokautiset palvelut. Hankinnan arvioitu vuosittainen arvo on 65 000 000 euroa. Lastensuojelun ympärivuorokautisten palveluiden hankinta sisältää seuraavat palvelutuotteet: 1) Ammatillinen perhehoito 2) Toimeksiantosuhteinen perhehoito 3) Toimeksiantosuhteinen vastaanottoperhetoiminta 4) Perustason laitoshoito 5) Erityistason laitoshoito 6) Vaativan tason laitoshoito 7) Erityinen huolenpito 8) Ympärivuorokautinen perhekuntoutus Hankinnan kohteena on tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä mainittu palvelu tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritetyllä tavalla. Hankinnassa noudatetaan lakia julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeussopimuksista (1397/2016, hankintalaki). Kyseessä on kansallisen kynnysarvon ylittävä hankinta. Hankintamenettelynä on hankintalain 32 §:n tarkoittama avoin menettely.

title: Finland – Dairy products – Maidon ja maitotaloustuotteiden hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on maidon ja maitotaloustuotteiden hankinta Vantaan Tilapalvelut Vantti Oy:n keittiöille sekä Vantaan ammatillisen oppilaitoksen Varian elintarvike- ja ravintola-alan opetuskeittiöille tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Tässä tarjouspyynnössä Tilaajalla tarkoitetaan Vantaan kaupunkia ja Vantaan Tilapalvelut Vantti Oy:tä, ellei asiayhteydestä muuta ilmene. Tämän kilpailutuksen perusteella tullaan tekemään erikseen sopimus maidon ja maitotaloustuotteiden hankinnasta Vantille ja Vantaan kaupungille. Vantaan Tilapalvelut Vantti Oy tilaa maidon ja maitotaloustuotteet koulujen ja päiväkotien keittiöille ruokapalvelutoimintaa ja ruoanvalmistusta varten. Vantaan kaupungin osalta hankinnan kohteena ovat ammattioppilaitos Varian elintarvike- ja ravintola-alan opetuskäyttöön tarvittavat maito- ja maitotaloustuotteet. Sopimusten suunniteltu alkamisajankohta on 1.11.2026. Sopimuskausi on määräaikainen ensimmäiset 24 kk ja jatkuu sen jälkeen toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Hankinnan arvioitu arvo on vuodessa n. 1 240 000 euroa (alv 0) ja se jakautuu seuraavasti: Vantaan kaupunki 40 000 euroa (alv 0) / vuosi Vantaan Tilapalvelut Vantti Oy 1,2 miljoonaa euroa (alv 0) / vuosi Tilaaja ei sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin tai euromääräisiin arvoihin sopimuskaudella.

title: Portugal – Refuse disposal and treatment – Acordo-Quadro Para Aquisição de Serviço De Transporte, Receção, Tratamento e Valorização de Resíduos de Construção e Demolição (RCD´S)
description: Acordo-Quadro Para Aquisição De Serviço De Transporte, Receção, Tratamento E Valorização De Resíduos De Construção E Demolição (RCD´S),constituído pelos seguintes lotes: a) Lote 1: Aluguer de contentores de 6 m3; b) Lote 2: Transporte de RCD's em toda a área geográfica das entidades adquirentes, a partir de locais a designar por cada entidade adquirente. Aquando da recolha de contentores cheios por parte do cocontratante, deverão ser, caso a entidade adquirente opte pelo serviço de aluguer de contentores, deixados no mesmo local o idêntico número de contentores vazios; c) Lote 3: Receção, tratamento e valorização de RCDs, incluindo encaminhamento seletivo dos resíduos a destino final adequado, ou seja a operadores licenciados para a valorização e/ou eliminação, em razão da sua natureza ou composição, garantindo os encargos e responsabilidades que advenham das operações mencionadas, assegurando que as mesmas se realizam de acordo com o princípio da hierarquia das preferências na gestão dos resíduos; Lote 4: Crédito oferecido pela entidade prestadora dos serviços a cada entidade adquirente, em função da quantidade de RCDs transportados e rececionados (a utilizar em aquisição de bens produzidos, total ou parcialmente, com RCD's ou com incorporação de fresados; ou, em alternativa, a deduzir quando da emissão mensal de fatura dos serviços prestados).

description: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Mexico City will launch the solicitation on SAM.gov when its available. The U.S. Embassy in Mexico City - Facility Management Office (FAC), requires a vendor that can supply brand-new Original equipment manufacturer spare parts at the New Embassy Compound (NEC). These spares are essential for the safe, reliable, and continuous operation of the Air conditioning systems installed throughout the facility. These supplies require that all replacement parts match the brand and model of the originally installed equipment to ensure compatibility with existing Air Handler Units (AHUs), maintain critical safety functions, and preserve manufacturer warranties. This will allow the FAC and OBO to accomplish the safe, reliable, and uninterrupted operation of the A/C system essential to Facility Operations. All items must be brand new and must match specific OEM part numbers and models. No substitutions will be accepted. Full specifications, part numbers, quantities, and delivery requirements will be provided in the RFQ upon solicitation launch. Pursuant to FAR 4.1102(a) Offerors must be registered in SAM at the time an offer is submitted in order to comply with the annual representations and certifications requirements. Failure to be registered at the time of proposal submission shall deem the offeror�s proposal to be considered non-responsive to the solicitation requirements and no further consideration will be given. Therefore, you are encouraged to complete the registration process and have an active account in sam.gov prior to proposal submission. The guidelines for registration in SAM are also available at: https://sam.gov/content/entity-landing Electronic Submission/Responses: This opportunity allows for electronic responses. Please submit your quotation prior to the response date and time.

title: J066-- STX Richard-Allan Epredia SVC
description: DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS Veterans Health Administration Network Contracting Office 17 (NCO 17) | Lab Services Support (LSS) 5441 Babcock Rd., Suite 302, San Antonio, TX 78240 JUSTIFICATION AND APPROVAL (J&A) FOR OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION In Accordance with FAR Subpart 6.3 and RFO FAR Part 6 Authority: 41 U.S.C. § 3304(a)(1) | FAR 6.302-1(a)(1) Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements Requirement Title: STX Richard-Allan Epredia Preventive Maintenance and Repair Services Acquisition Plan Action ID: 36C257-26-AP-4177 Purchase Request No.: 671-26-4-121-0661 JOFOC Log Number: FY26 - NCO 17 - 1828 Date Prepared: July 20, 2026 Contracting Activity: Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration Contracting Office: RPO West | Network Contracting Office 17 (NCO 17) | Lab Services Support (LSS) NAICS Code: 811210 Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance PSC Code: J066 Maintenance/Repair/Rebuild of Equipment: Industrial and Manufacturing Machinery Contract Type: Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) | Commercial Service | FAR Part 12 Proposed Contractor: Richard-Allan Scientific, LLC. (d/b/a Epredia) UEI / CAGE: N1LPLL6K6S58 / 044N0 Period of Performance: Base Year: August 1, 2026 July 31, 2027, plus Four (4) One-Year Option Periods through July 31, 2031 Estimated Total Contract Value: $93,326.00 (Base + 4 Option Years) 1. CONTRACTING ORGANIZATION AND CONTRACTING ACTIVITY (FAR 6.303-2(b)(1)) This Justification and Approval (J&A) is prepared by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), RPO West, Network Contracting Office 17 (NCO 17), Lab Services Support (LSS), located at 5441 Babcock Rd., Suite 302, San Antonio, TX 78240, on behalf of the South Texas Veterans Health Care System (STVHCS), San Antonio, Texas. This document is identified as a 'Justification for Other Than Full and Open Competition' in accordance with FAR 6.303-2(b)(1). 2. NATURE AND DESCRIPTION OF ACTION BEING APPROVED (FAR 6.303-2(b)(2)) This J&A supports the award of a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP), sole source contract to Richard-Allan Scientific, LLC. (d/b/a Epredia), the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), for preventive maintenance and repair services for two (2) Epredia Excelsior Tissue Processors and one (1) Epredia HM525 Cryostat located in the Histology Laboratory of the Pathology & Laboratory Medicine Service at the South Texas Veterans Health Care System (STVHCS), Audie L. Murphy VA Hospital, San Antonio, Texas. The contract will be awarded using FAR Part 12 commercial service procedures and consists of a Base Year with four (4) one-year option periods (Base + 4 OYs), with an estimated total value of $93,326.00. The contract is a continuation of expiring Contract No. 36C25721P0979 (awarded 08/01/2021; expiring 08/01/2026; total value $93,990.00). 3. DESCRIPTION OF SUPPLIES OR SERVICES AND ESTIMATED VALUE (FAR 6.303-2(b)(3)) The Government requires OEM preventive maintenance and repair services for the following proprietary laboratory instrumentation currently installed and in active service at the STVHCS Histology Laboratory: (2) Richard-Allan Scientific, LLC. / Epredia Excelsior Tissue Processors S/N: ET55941709 and S/N: 3ET56691710 (1) Richard-Allan Scientific, LLC. / Epredia HM525 Cryostat S/N: CNX05692307EP The Contractor service program shall include, at a minimum: Onsite repair by Certified Richard-Allan Scientific, LLC. (Epredia) Field Service Engineers (FSEs) All replacement parts, labor, travel, and expenses for unscheduled repair visits One (1) annual scheduled Preventive Maintenance (PM) onsite visit All applicable instrument shipping charges 24/7 toll-free hotline with same-day response capability Emergency repair within twenty-four (24) hours from time of request Same-day repair when both instruments are simultaneously non-operational All repairs performed during normal working hours, 8:00 AM 5:00 PM, Monday Friday Services must comply with AABB and CAP accreditation requirements and VHA Directive 1106. Period of performance: Base Year August 1, 2026 July 31, 2027, plus OY1 through OY4 through July 31, 2031. Estimated total contract value (Base + 4 OYs): $93,326.00. 4. IDENTIFICATION OF THE STATUTORY AUTHORITY (FAR 6.303-2(b)(4)) The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition for this procurement is: 41 U.S.C. § 3304(a)(1) Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements, as implemented by FAR 6.302-1(a)(1) and RFO FAR Part 6 (GSA Class Deviation, effective 2025 2026). Pursuant to FAR 6.302-1(b), this authority is used in preference to FAR 6.302-7 (Public Interest). None of the other circumstances enumerated at FAR 6.302-2 through 6.302-6 are applicable to this procurement. 5. DEMONSTRATION THAT PROPOSED CONTRACTOR'S UNIQUE QUALIFICATIONS OR THE NATURE OF THE ACQUISITION REQUIRES USE OF AUTHORITY CITED (FAR 6.303-2(b)(5)) 5.1 Proprietary Nature of Instrumentation: The Epredia Excelsior Tissue Processors and the Epredia HM525 Cryostat are proprietary, OEM-designed instruments manufactured and sold exclusively by Richard-Allan Scientific, LLC. (Epredia). The technical design, internal components, diagnostic algorithms, and calibration protocols for these instruments are proprietary intellectual property of Epredia, protected under applicable patent, trade secret, and intellectual property rights (FAR 6.302-1(b)(2)). Epredia does not publish, disclose, or license its technical service data, repair procedures, or calibration specifications to third parties. No independent third-party service organizations are authorized, trained, or certified by the OEM to perform maintenance or repairs on Epredia Excelsior Tissue Processors or the HM525 Cryostat. 5.2 OEM-Certified Field Service Engineers: Maintenance, repair, and calibration of the Epredia Excelsior Tissue Processors and HM525 Cryostat must be performed exclusively by Certified Richard-Allan Scientific, LLC. (Epredia) Field Service Engineers (FSEs). These FSEs possess exclusive access to OEM diagnostic tools, proprietary service software, technical service manuals, and OEM-approved replacement parts that are unavailable to any other service organization. Use of non-OEM-certified personnel would void manufacturer warranties, could cause instrument damage, and would constitute non-compliance with AABB and CAP accreditation requirements, directly jeopardizing the STVHCS Histology Laboratory's accreditation status and its ability to provide diagnostic pathology services to Veterans. 5.3 Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance: The STVHCS Histology Laboratory is accredited by both the American Association of Blood Banks (AABB) and the College of American Pathologists (CAP). Both accrediting bodies require that laboratory instrumentation be maintained and calibrated in accordance with the OEM's service standards, performed by OEM-certified personnel. VHA Directive 1106 additionally mandates compliance with these accreditation requirements for all VHA laboratory operations. Failure to use OEM-certified service personnel would place the STVHCS's AABB and CAP accreditation at risk, which would suspend the laboratory's ability to perform histological analyses and directly disrupt Veterans' access to pathology and cancer diagnostic services. 5.4 Continuity of Veteran Care: The Epredia Excelsior Tissue Processors and HM525 Cryostat are essential, mission-critical instruments used daily in the Histology Laboratory for the processing and sectioning of surgical and biopsy tissue specimens submitted for pathological diagnosis, including cancer diagnosis. Any disruption in the availability or reliability of these instruments directly delays diagnostic results for Veterans receiving care at the STVHCS. title: Finland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Technical Consultancy Services Related to Rolling Stock
description: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE PROCUREMENT RailStock Finland Oy (hereinafter “Railstock”) is launching a tendering procedure for technical consultancy services related to the rolling stock it manages. The purpose of this procurement is to establish a framework for obtaining high‑quality, independent technical consultancy services that support Railstock in the management, development and procurement of rolling stock used in publicly funded passenger rail services in Finland. CONTRACTING ENTITY Railstock Finland Oy is a company wholly owned by the State of Finland, which manages, develops and leases passenger rolling stock for publicly funded passenger rail services in Finland. The objective of the company is to ensure that the rolling stock used in contracted services is safe, modern, low‑emission and available to all operators on equal and transparent terms, so that competition in rail transport and sustainable modes of transport can develop. Railstock is responsible for the preparation and implementation of new rolling stock procurements, for lifecycle management of the rolling stock and for long‑term investment planning. The company began operating as an independent company under the ownership steering of the Prime Minister’s Office in November 2025, and practical operational activities have commenced during 2026 as rolling stock used in contracted services, transferred from VR and other parties, is brought into the company’s ownership. SCOPE OF THE PROCUREMENT The subject matter of the procurement is a comprehensive package of technical expert and consultancy services related to rolling stock, supporting the rolling stock owner in, inter alia, technical assessments, procurement preparation, lifecycle management, planning of maintenance and heavy overhauls, safety and approval matters, as well as other expert tasks connected with the ownership and development of rolling stock. Railstock has divided the procurement into the following lots: 1. Owner’s Engineer Support 2. Procurement Support (Rolling Stock) 3. Lifecycle, LCC & Fleet Strategy 4. Safety, Regulation & ECM Certification 5. Testing, Acceptance, Audits & QA 6. Maintenance, Overhaul & Modification Procurement 7. ESG Reporting 8. IT Systems, Network Architecture & Cybersecurity 9. Technical Design (Electrical & Mechanical) 10. ETCS Retrofit & Upgrade Procurement Support 11. Rolling Stock Documentation Management & DMS Support The lots and the services to be procured under each lot are described in more detail in the invitation to tender and its annexes, which also set out Railstock’s requirements concerning the suitability of tenderers and the minimum requirements applicable to the services. PROCUREMENT DOCUMENTS The procurement documents consist of the following documents: - This contract notice - Annex 1: Draft Agreement - Annex 1.1: Data Protection, Information Security and Confidentiality Annex - Annex 1.2: Sanctions undertakings - Annex 2.1: Service description, Lot 1 - Annex 2.2: Service description, Lot 2 - Annex 2.3: Service description, Lot 3 - Annex 2.4: Service description, Lot 4 - Annex 2.5: Service description, Lot 5 - Annex 2.6: Service description, Lot 6 - Annex 2.7: Service description, Lot 7 - Annex 2.8: Service description, Lot 8 - Annex 2.9: Service description, Lot 9 - Annex 2.10: Service description, Lot 10 - Annex 2.11: Service description, Lot 11 - Annex 3.1: Tender Form, Lot 1 - Annex 3.2: Tender Form, Lot 2 - Annex 3.3: Tender Form, Lot 3 - Annex 3.4: Tender Form, Lot 4 - Annex 3.5: Tender Form, Lot 5 - Annex 3.6: Tender Form, Lot 6 - Annex 3.7: Tender Form, Lot 7 - Annex 3.8: Tender Form, Lot 8 - Annex 3.9: Tender Form, Lot 9 - Annex 3.10: Tender Form, Lot 10 - Annex 3.11: Tender Form, Lot 11 - Annex 4: Subcontractors, capacity‑providing entities and members of a group of tenderers PROCUREMENT TIMETABLE - Deadline for requests for additional information: 9 August 2026 - Answers to requests for additional information: at the latest 6 days before the tender submission deadline (target date: 12 August 2026) - Tender submission deadline: 23 August 2026 After this, the procurement will proceed according to the following indicative timetable: - Notification of the contract award decision: 18 September 2026 - Signing of the contract and start of the contract period: 9 October 2026

title: Finland – Snow-clearing services – Katujen talvikunnossapito
description: Kyseessä on EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä hankinta ja hankintamenettelynä on avoin menettely. Hankintailmoitus on julkaistu HILMA- palvelussa osoitteessa www.hankintailmoitukset.fi. Sopimuskausi, urakan kuvaus, urakkahinnat ja tarjouksen vertailuperusteet Sopimukset tehdään ajalle 1.11.2026 – 31.10.2027 ja sen jälkeen tilaajalla on mahdollisuus jatkaa sopimukset optiokaudelle: 1.11.2027 – 31.10.2031. Talvikunnossapidon urakointiin lähdetään kunnan päivystyksen ilmoituksesta. Päätoteuttajana toimivan pääurakoitsijan on itsenäisesti valvottava omaa ja mahdollisten aliurakoitsijoidensa työnsuoritusta Ilmajoen kunnan antamien talvihoidon kriteerien perusteella. Tilaaja maksaa urakoitsijoille yksikköhintojen ja työsuoritteiden mukaisesti lasketun urakkasumman ja sen lisäksi varallaolokorvauksen. Varallaolokorvaus sisältää talvikauden 1.11 – 30.4 välisenä aikana varallaolo- ja päivystysvalmiuden, siirtymät urakkakohteisiin tarjouspyynnön mukaisin ehdoin ja kunnan hankkimien aurauskeppien poiston. Mikäli kunnan hoidossa olevan tie- ja katuverkoston tai kiinteistöiden laajuuteen tulee muutoksia, tilaaja voi muuttaa urakan laajuutta. Tällöin urakkahintaa tarkistetaan urakka-alueen muutoksen suhteessa ja mikäli urakka-alueen laajuuden muutostarve on yli 10%, tarkistuksen määrästä ja kustannusvaikutuksesta neuvotellaan ja sovitaan urakoitsijan kanssa erikseen. Tarjouskilpailun toteutus on kuvattu tarjouspyynnössä tarkemmin.

title: Project Manager
description: Commission Brief: Project Manager Restoring St Peter's Church and Revitalising Thetford's Heritage The full Commission Brief is attached to this Notice. Project Summary This National Lottery Heritage Fund-supported project will undertake essential capital works, with approximately 80% focused on urgent conservation needs-addressing roof failure, water ingress, and decaying historic fabric. The remaining 20% of the capital works will deliver reversible interventions to enable sustainable, flexible use. Application Process The procurement process will be undertaken in accordance with: • The Procurement Act 2023 • Thetford Town Council Financial Regulations • The Council's Procurement Strategy • The National Lottery Heritage Fund procurement guidance For clarity, the appointment will include an anticipated break period of approximately six months between submission of the Delivery Phase application and receipt of Permission to Start for the Delivery Phase. The Heritage Fund does not fund Project Management Consultancy costs during this interim period. The Council does not guarantee payment or continuation during this period unless separate funding is formally approved by Thetford Town Council. Re-appointment or continuation into the Delivery phase will be subject to successful Delivery Phase approval, satisfactory performance, affordability, funding availability and formal Council approval. The opportunity will be advertised on Contracts Finder in accordance with the council's Financial Regulations and Procurement Strategy. Tender submissions must be submitted electronically to: Sonya Wright Town Clerk Thetford Town Council Email: sonyawright@thetfordtowncouncil.gov.uk Deadline for submissions: 23rd August 2026 Clarification questions must be submitted in writing to the contact listed above. All responses to clarification questions may be circulated to all tenderers where appropriate to ensure fairness and transparency. Shortlisted tenderers may be invited to present their approaches to representatives of Thetford Town Council and key project stakeholders. The successful tenderer will be required to enter into a formal contract with Thetford Town Council. Form of Contract The successful tenderer will be required to enter into a formal consultancy agreement with Thetford Town Council. The initial appointment will commence with the Development Phase of the Project, with the potential continuation into the Delivery Phase subject to the conditions set out within Section 7 of this brief. The Council reserves the right to extend the appointment into the Delivery Phase, subject to: A formal break clause shall apply between the Development and Delivery Phases. Continuation beyond the Development Phase shall remain entirely at the discretion of Thetford Town Council and subject to satisfactory performance, successful Heritage Fund Delivery Phase approval, affordability, and ongoing project viability.

title: Deliveries of Bulk Liquid Oxygen for the Landstuhl Regional Medical Center (LRMC), Germany
description: **Solicitation Type:** Request for Quotation (RFQ) **1. KEY REQUIREMENT DETAILS** The Defense Health Agency (DHA) Contracting Activity Europe has a requirement for a single-award, Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) commercial supply contract for: * **Product:** Medicinal Bulk Liquid Oxygen (Purity >=99.5%, USP/DAB/EUAB compliant). * **Equipment:** Rental, telemetry monitoring, and comprehensive maintenance of one (1) vertical bulk storage tank. * **Contract Structure:** Single award IDIQ consisting of four (1) one-year ordering periods (Base Year + 3 additional Ordering Years). * **FOB Terms:** Destination (delivery terms include a single delivery fee per run, automatic refills at 20% capacity, and a 4-hour emergency delivery response). **2. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE & DELIVERY LOCATION** All deliveries and tank maintenance will occur at: * Landstuhl Regional Medical Center (LRMC) * Medical Material Branch, Building 3740 * Kirchberg Kaserne, 66849 Landstuhl, Germany * DoDAAC: HT0880 **3. REGULATORY & SAFETY COMPLIANCE** * **T�V Testing:** The Contractor is responsible for performing, coordinating, and funding all mandatory periodic Technischer �berwachungsverein (T�V) / TUEA safety testing and certifications on the bulk storage tank in accordance with German safety regulations (*Betriebssicherheitsverordnung*). * **Language:** Delivery drivers and contractor point of contact must be fluent in English. **4. QUOTE SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS** To be considered for award, offerors must submit a complete quote package via email containing the following documents: 1. **Completed SF 1449:** Blocks 17a, 30a, 30b, and 30c must be filled out and signed. 2. **Completed Pricing Schedule:** Offerors must insert unit prices and extended amounts for all Contract Line Item Numbers (CLINs) across the Base Period and all Option Periods. 3. **Technical Capability Documentation:** A written statement or a sample Certificate of Analysis (CoA) demonstrating the ability to supply Medicinal Bulk Liquid Oxygen meeting the required purity standard (>=99.5%) and compliance with USP, DAB, or EUAB monographs. 4. **Company Information:** Vendor's active SAM.gov Unique Entity ID (UEI) and CAGE/NCAGE code to verify active SAM registration. **5. IMPORTANT DEADLINES & SUBMISSION INFO** * **Questions Due:** All questions must be submitted via email no later than **14 August 2026 at 16:00 CET**. * **Quotes Due Date:** **23 September 2026 at 16:00 (4:00 PM) Central European Time (CET)**. * **Submission Contacts:** * Contract Specialist: Mr. Henning Mayer-Goldstein (`HenningFalk.Mayer-Goldstein.LN@health.mil`) * Contracting Officer: Mr. Matthew R. Elden (`Matthew.R.Elden.civ@health.mil`) Quotes must be submitted electronically and include all requirements outlined above and within the RFQ document. Vendors must have an active SAM.gov registration at the time of quote submission to be eligible for award.

title: CMMC Virtual Industry Day
description: The Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division (NSWC IHD) will host a Virtual Industry Day on August 26, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM EST. This virtual event will feature brief descriptions from various NSWC IHD departments on how they support the command's mission, alongside briefings on Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) requirements and upcoming small business opportunities. All interested industry partners must complete their registration online by the August 23, 2026, deadline. To help industry partners better understand our operations and align their capabilities with our mission, the event will feature presentations from several NSWC IHD departments. Representatives from these departments will provide brief descriptions of what they do, their technical focus areas, and their operational roles within Indian Head. These briefs will give small businesses direct insight into the command's diverse research, development, and engineering activities, helping potential partners identify where their services and technologies can best support NSWC IHD. Furthermore, the event will host briefs from the U.S. Army�s Next-Generation Commercial Operations in Defended Enclaves (NCODE) Team and MoveAmerica. The U.S. Army�s Next-Generation Commercial Operations in Defended Enclaves (NCODE) Team, operating under the Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Army for Data, Engineering, and Software [DASA(DES)] team is spearheading a critical modernization and security initiative for the Department of War's supply chain, focusing on helping small DIB contractors overcome the technical and financial barriers associated with strict federal cybersecurity mandates like CMMC and NIST SP 800-171. Additionally, representatives from MoveAmerica will join the session to discuss practical approaches to compliance and highlight MoveAmerica�s specific CMMC support capabilities. MoveAmerica is a Maryland-based 501(c)(3) non-profit organization and an emerging thought leader in domestic industrial base development, national security, and supply chain resilience. Through its close partnerships with APEX Accelerators, the Department of War, the Department of Commerce, and the State of Maryland, MoveAmerica works to advance research, development, and consortia management. This event will be conducted entirely online, and attendance is strictly limited to two (2) representatives per company to ensure virtual platform stability. Interested participants must register prior to the August 23, 2026 deadline by visiting the Registration Link: https://forms.osi.apps.mil/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=AD4z43fIh0u2rUXpQt4XUEhUxU0rlzJGosGSdgwOHspUMDJUUElNM040VUJSRkxaRlFBSTJXSTQwSy4u&origin=lprLink&route=shorturl Registered attendees will receive a follow-up email prior to the event date containing the official virtual meeting link, access instructions, and the final agenda.

description: Request for Information (RFI) Notice Type: Sources Sought Solicitation: W31P4Q-27-R-A046 Classification Code: 14 � Guided Missiles PSC: J014 � Maintenance, Repair and Rebuilding of Equipment: Guided Missiles NAICS Code: 336419 - Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing Synopsis: This notice is published in accordance with FAR 10.002 and 15.201(e) and is a Request for Information (RFI) only in support of market research. The Government�s intent is to identify qualified companies capable of providing total system performance responsibilities and support and sustainment services for the Homing All Way Killer (HAWK) Missile Systems, PSC J014, NAICS code 336419. This is an RFI/SOURCES SOUGHT notice to request information for Government planning purposes only. Responses will assist the government in planning acquisition strategy for a potential future acquisition. The government is not committed to issue a solicitation or award a contract as a result of this announcement. Army Contracting Command � Redstone Arsenal (ACC-RSA) is seeking qualified and capable potential vendors. Since this is an RFI/Sources Sought and not a solicitation for receipt of proposal or quotations, the government does not encourage questions concerning the RFI/Sources Sought. The Army Contracting Center, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama is issuing an RFI/Sources Sought for Fair Share Sustainment Operations (FSSO) Program and Contract Logistics Services (CLS). The PWS tasks contractor to provide total system performance responsibility and to provide support / sustainment services to the Security Assistance Management Directorate (SAMD) for the HAWK Missile System. description: Lukitusuudistukset toteutetaan VAV:n omistamiin, Vantaalla sijaitseviin kymmeneen (10) kiinteistöön. Kiinteistöt ovat: Antaksentie 21, Arinatie 7, Asolantie 22, Keikarinkuja 2, Kolohongankuja 6, Lummetie 11, Maarukarinne 5, Minkkitie 11, Ollaksentie 31 & Sahatie 2. Toteutettava lukitusjärjestelmä on omavoimainen, etähallittava, suojattu, muuntautumiskykyinen ja järjestelmäpohjainen lukitus, jonka tavoitteena on varmistaa kiinteistön ja sen käyttäjien korkeatasoinen avainturvallisuus. Kaikki avainpesät ja avaimet ovat elektromekaanisia ja niiden molempien perustoiminta ilman kello- ja aikaominaisuuksia tulee tapahtua ilman ulkoista virtalähdettä kuten ladattavia / vaihdettavia akkuja tai paristoja. Kaikki lukot, myös kalustelukot tulee voida ohjelmoida samaan lukostoon siten, että käyttäjän sama avain toimii tarvittaessa kaikissa lukoissa. Avaimiin pitää saada tarvittaessa yksilöivä leimaus, jolla voidaan eritellä avaimet avainhallintaohjelmistossa. Aikaohjatut / aikarajatut ovet varustetaan lukijoilla mahdollistaen tunnistekulkemisen. Tunnisteena voidaan käyttää joko avainta, tai irrallista tunnistetta tarpeen mukaan. Kulkutunnisteen tulee olla liitetty kiinteästi lukitusjärjestelmän avaimeen ja molemmat tulee olla mahdollista luoda yhdestä ohjelmistosta. Avainpesät, avaimet sekä tarvittavat ohjelmistot lisensseineen toimitetaan asennettuna ja ohjelmoituna siten että lukot ja avaimet ovat käyttökunnossa. Järjestelmään on voitava liittää PIN-näppäimistöllä varustettuja avaimia päivittäviä lukijalaitteita. Avainturvallisuuden vuoksi tieto kadonneista avaimista tulee siirtyä avaimeen etälukijasta ja viedä se edelleen muille itsenäisille lukoille. Järjestelmään on voitava liittää myös mobiiliavaimilla käytettäviä avainsäilön avainpesiä sekä muita mobiiliavaimilla käytettäviä lukkoja. Vakuutusrajapintaovien lukoissa tulee käyttää SFS 7020/SFS 5970 vaatimusten mukaisesti hyväksyttyjen 1-luokan avainpesien ulkoheloja. Kulkuoikeudet lukoille ja avaimille sovitaan erillisessä tilaajan kanssa pidettävässä lukituspalaverissa. Pohjakuvien vienti ohjelmistoon lukitusmerkinnöillä sisältyy urakkaan. Lukostot perustetaan järjestelmään kyseisen yhtiön lukoston alle. Tarjouksen laadinta Tarjous on laadittava niin, että työn laajuus, suunnittelutyöt, lukitussuunnittelu, ohjelmointityöt, tarvittavat asennus- ja muut työt ovat sisällytetty tarjoukseen. Tarjouksessa on otettava huomioon myös se, että tuotteiden asentaminen vaatii oven työstämistä. Mikäli ovessa ei voida vaihtaa vain avainpesää, niin tarjoushinnan tulee sisältää tarvittavat lukkorungot, sekä muut komponentit asennustöineen, mukaan lukien mahdolliset asbestityöt. Tarjoukseen on sisällytettävä kaikki tarvittavat työt, tuotteet ja tarvikkeet täysin valmiiksi asennettuna ja käyttöönotettuna niin, että järjestelmät ovat täysin toimintakuntoisia ja dokumentoituja. Tarjoukseen on sisällytettävä lukituspalavereita tarvittava määrä yhdessä Tilaajan kanssa. Tarjoukseen on sisällytettävä myös kohdekartoitus ja suunnittelu. Tarjouksen tulee sisältää kaikki mahdolliset oville tarvittavat tietoliikenne ym. kaapeloinnit kiinteistöllä ja niihin liittyvät tarvikkeet. Ennen tarjouksen jättämistä tarjoajan tulee tutustua tarjouspyynnön kohteisiin tarjouksen hinnan muodostumisen kannalta riittävällä tarkkuudella muun muassa kaapelointimäärien arvioimaksi. Mahdolliset poikkeamat on esitettävä ennen tarjouksen jättöä. Kohdekäynnit järjestetään sovitusti, yhteyshenkilönä: sirpa.rinne@vav.fi ja tea.holmberg@vav.fi. Tarjouksen liitteenä olevat määrä- ja laiteluettelot ovat suuntaa antavia ja pyydämme tarjousta kyseistä tuotteesta tai vastaavasta. Mikäli kiinteistöllä tarvitaan lukostoon SIM-kortillinen laajakaistayhteys, tehdään tämä hankinta Tilaajan kautta. Tarjouksessa pyydämme lisäksi hintaa lukkosepän tuntityöstä. Lukkosepän tuntityöhinta toimii mahdollisina lisä- ja muutostyöhintoina. Kaikista urakan yhteydessä toteutettavista mahdollisista lisä- ja muutostöistä tulee sopia etukäteen tilaajan kanssa. Tarjoukseen on sisällytettävä lukoston hallinnoinnin hajauttamisesta aiheutuvat kulut, ohjelmointilaitteet yms. tunnisteet ohjelmistoon pääsyä varten. Laskennallisesti 3 hajautettua käyttäjää, jotka toimivat fyysisesti eri toimipisteissä. Tarjoajan tulee jättää tarjous kaikista kokonaisurakkaan sisältyvistä kiinteistöistä ja niiden lukitusuudistusurakoista. Tarjoukset jätetään huomioiden, että jokaiselle kiinteistölle määritellään oma kiinteistökohtainen hinta. Tarjouksen tulee perustua tarjouspyyntöön ja sen liitteisiin. Tarjouksen tulee sisältää kaikki ne tiedot ja kaikki aineisto, joka esitetty toimitettavaksi tarjouksen yhteydessä.

title: Greece – Refurbishment work – ΑΠΟΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΝΤΑΞΗ ΝΕΩΝ ΧΡΗΣΕΩΝ ΣΤO ΣΥΓΚΡΟΤΗΜΑ ΤΩΝ ΔΥΤΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΝΑΤΟΛΙΚΩΝ ΕΝΕΤΙΚΩΝ ΝΕΩΡΙΩΝ ΤΟΥ ΗΡΑΚΛΕΙΟΥ ΚΡΗΤΗΣ
description: Το έργο περιλαμβάνει την αποκατάσταση και απόδοση σε χρήση του συγκροτήματος των Δυτικών και Ανατολικών Νεωρίων στο Ηράκλειο. Το κτηριακό συγκρότημα προστατεύεται σύμφωνα με την κήρυξη που περιλαμβάνεται στο ΒΔ 21-2-1947, με το οποίο τα υφιστάμενα λείψανα των ενετικών νεωρίων κηρύχτηκαν ως ιστορικά διατηρητέα μνημεία, μεταξύ άλλων μεσαιωνικών μνημείων της πόλης του Ηρακλείου Κρήτης (ΦΕΚ 45/Α/18-3-1947). Tα δυτικά νεώρια αποτελούνται από τέσσερεις εν σειρά διατεταγμένους θολωτούς χώρους και είναι μέρος του συγκροτήματος των Παλαιών Νεωρίων (Arsenali Vecchi) που κτίστηκαν το 1556. Σε μικρή απόσταση στα δυτικά τους βρίσκεται η λεγόμενη δυτική αποθήκη. Από τα ανατολικά νεώρια (Arsenali Nuovi και Nuovissimi) που κτίστηκαν το 1608 διατηρείται ένας θολωτός χώρος. Στο συγκρότημά τους περιλαμβάνεται η αποθήκη Άλατος, ένα μονόχωρο θολοσκεπές κτήριο και η δεξαμενή Ζάνε, αποτελούμενη από δύο θολωτούς χώρους. Στα Δυτικά Νεώρια προβλέπονται εργασίες ενίσχυσης της τοιχοποιίας (ενέματα, συμπληρώσεις), αρμολογήματα, καθαρισμοί και συντηρήσεις λίθων, συντηρήσεις επιχρισμάτων, νέα επικάλυψη της στέγης και αντιμετώπιση της υγρασίας με κατασκευή συστήματος αποστράγγισης. Επίσης, προβλέπεται η ένταξη νέων κατασκευών, δηλαδή υαλοστασίων, προθηκών, πάγκου υποδοχής, αμφιθεάτρου, φωτιστικών ιστών και νέων ηλεκτρομηχανολογικών εγκαταστάσεων καθώς και νέα δαπεδόστρωση. Στη Δυτική Αποθήκη προβλέπονται εργασίες ενίσχυσης της τοιχοποιίας (ενέματα, συμπληρώσεις, αναδομήσεις), αρμολογήματα, ανακατασκευή του κατεστραμμένου θόλου και διαμόρφωση βατού δώματος επ’ αυτού. Επίσης προβλέπεται η ένταξη νέων κατασκευών, δηλαδή κουφωμάτων, πάγκων και εξοπλισμού, χωρισμάτων και χώρων υγιεινής, με νέα ηλεκτρομηχανολογική εγκατάσταση και δαπεδόστρωση. Στα Ανατολικά νεώρια προβλέπονται εργασίες ενίσχυσης της τοιχοποιίας και του θόλου (ενέματα, συμπληρώσεις, ελκυστήρες), αρμολογήματα, καθαρισμοί και συντηρήσεις λίθων, συντηρήσεις επιχρισμάτων, νέα επικάλυψη της στέγης, διαμόρφωση του δαπέδου προκειμένου να εξασφαλιστεί πρόσβαση στην παρακείμενη δεξαμενή Ζάνε, κιγκλιδώματα, στηθαία, δαπεδόστρωση και φωτισμός. Στη δεξαμενή Ζάνε προβλέπονται εργασίες ενίσχυσης της τοιχοποιίας και των θόλων (ενέματα, συμπληρώσεις), αρμολογήματα, καθαρισμοί και συντηρήσεις λίθων, συντηρήσεις επιχρισμάτων, ανακατασκευή της επικάλυψης των θόλων. Επίσης, προβλέπεται η ένταξη νέων κατασκευών, δηλαδή υαλοστασίων, διαδρόμων, κλιμάκων, αναβαθρών, θεάτρου, χώρων υγιεινής, καθώς και νέες ηλεκτρομηχανολογικές εγκαταστάσεις. Στην Αποθήκη Άλατος προβλέπονται εργασίες ενίσχυσης της τοιχοποιίας (ενέματα, συμπληρώσεις, ελκυστήρες), αρμολογήματα, καθαρισμοί και συντηρήσεις λίθων, συντηρήσεις επιχρισμάτων, νέα επικάλυψη της στέγης και επισκευή του στηθαίου. Προβλέπεται επίσης η κατασκευή ξύλινου εσωτερικού εξοπλισμού και μεταλλικών κατασκευών για τη λειτουργία του χώρου για περιοδικές εκθέσεις, καθώς και νέα ηλεκτρομηχανολογική εγκατάσταση με αναβατόριο ΑμεΑ και δαπεδόστρωση. Στον περιβάλλοντα χώρο και τα δώματα των μνημείων προβλέπονται εργασίες διαμόρφωσης, με δαπεδοστρώσεις, κιγκλιδώματα, κλίμακες, αναβάθρες, υπερυψωμένα επίπεδα -εξέδρες, στέγαστρα, φωτισμό. Θα τοποθετηθούν επίσης πινακίδες πληροφόρησης κοινού και σε γραφή Braille.

Professional Boundaries: Under no circumstances shall any relationship resembling an employer-employee (co-employment) relationship be established between the Government and contractor personnel. Service Contract Act (SCA) / Service Contract Labor Standards (SCLS) Compliance To maintain regulatory alignment with 41 U.S.C. Chapter 67 (Service Contract Labor Standards) and to prevent labor misclassification or Wage Determination violations: Mandated Labor Classification: Offerors shall utilize the mandatory SCA labor category of Medical Record Clerk (Labor Category Code 12160) to execute all requirements outlined in this PWS. Wage and Benefit Floor: All proposed labor rates must strictly conform to or exceed the minimum wage and fringe benefit requirements established in the applicable Department of Labor (DOL) Wage Determination attached to this solicitation. Strictly Administrative Scope: The duties outlined under this contract are exclusively clerical, administrative, and data-driven. The Medical Record Clerk is a non-clinical role. Contractor personnel are strictly prohibited from performing any tasks that require clinical evaluation, medical charting, clinical triage, patient counseling, or the independent authoring of medical/dental opinions. Mandatory Personnel Qualifications. The Contractor shall ensure that all personnel assigned to perform services under this contract possess and maintain, at a minimum, the following mandatory professional qualifications: Professional Experience Healthcare Administration Background: A minimum of two (2) years of demonstrated, hands-on experience in medical or dental administration, medical records management, military health administration, or a related healthcare clerical field. Records Management Proficiency: Proven experience handling sensitive personal data, physical/electronic archiving, and verifying the administrative completeness of standardized medical/dental intake documentation. Technical and Computer Skills Microsoft Office Suite: Demonstrated high-level proficiency in using the Microsoft Office Suite, specifically: Microsoft Excel: Ability to manage spreadsheets, utilize basic formulas, and organize data for weekly metrics reporting. Microsoft Word: Ability to draft professional administrative correspondence and schedules. Microsoft Outlook: Ability to coordinate scheduling and professional communication across secure email networks. Systems Adaptability: Proven capability to quickly learn and perform high-accuracy data entry within proprietary military and federal web-based databases (including but not limited to MEDCHART, eCase, DENCLASS, and MEDPROS) following initial Government-provided systems training. Security and Information Assurance Clearance: Federal Clearability: All personnel must be U.S. citizens and must be capable of successfully passing a federal Tier 1 background investigation (formerly National Agency Check with Inquiries - NACI) to secure a Common Access Card (CAC) for physical installation access and logical access to secure military networks. Data Privacy Competency: Prior experience handling Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in strict compliance with HIPAA, HITECH, and military privacy regulations.

title: Breathing Air Machine Repair and Shop Air Compressor Maintenance
description: Sources Sought Notice Breathing Air Machine Repair and Shop Air Compressor Maintenance for the Connecticut Air National Guard 1. Notice Details Notice ID: W50SC226QA003 Agency: Department of the Air Force, Air National Guard Office: 103rd Airlift Wing, Connecticut Air National Guard Location: Bradley Air National Guard Base, East Granby, CT Posted Date: 8/18/2026 Response Date: 8/23/2026, 5PM EDT Classification Code: J043 � Maintenance, Repair, and Rebuilding of Equipment: Pumps and Compressors NAICS Code: 811310 � Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance (Small Business Size Standard: $12.5 million) 2. Description This is a Sources Sought notice for market research purposes only, not a solicitation for proposals. The 103rd Airlift Wing of the Connecticut Air National Guard is seeking to identify qualified small businesses located in the Connecticut region with the capability to perform maintenance and repair services for a breathing air machine and shop air compressors as detailed in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). The Government will use the information submitted in response to this notice to determine the appropriate acquisition strategy for a potential future procurement. 3. Scope of Work The contractor shall provide all personnel, tools, equipment, materials, and supervision to perform a five-part project. The key requirements include: Part 1: Replace the failing water separator trap and drain assembly on the breathing air system. Part 2: Install a drip leg with a ball valve at the inlet of the breathing air dryer to collect excess condensate. Part 3: Replace both tower pressure switches on the Hankinson model 95CBA air dryer and resolve any recorded faults. Part 4: Replace eight (8) Wilkerson in-line filter elements within the breathing air distribution lines. Part 5: Provide comprehensive annual service for two (2) Chicago Pneumatic air compressors, including filter and oil changes, system checks, cleaning, and operational testing. All work performed must be leak-checked, and equipment must be tested and left in fully operational condition. The contractor must comply with all applicable Federal, State, and OSHA safety and environmental regulations. 4. Submission Requirements Interested parties are invited to submit a capabilities statement demonstrating their ability to perform the services described above. The submission should not exceed five (5) pages and must include the following information: Company Information: Company name, address, phone number, and point of contact (POC) with email address. Business Size and Status: Business size (e.g., small business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB) under the specified NAICS code 811310. Identification Numbers: Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and CAGE code. Capability Narrative: A brief description of your company's capabilities and experience performing similar projects. Geographic Proximity: Confirmation that your business is located within or has the ability to service the Connecticut region. 5. Submission Instructions Please submit your capabilities statement via email to MSgt Delmar Munoz: delmar.munoz.mil@army.mil no later than the response date and time listed above. The subject line of the email should read: "Sources Sought Response: Breathing Air Machine Repair � [Your Company Name]". 6. Disclaimer This notice is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This notice does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. The Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice.

title: Samarbejdspartner til koordinering og gennemførelse af sparringspaneler for iværksættere
description: Erhvervshusene søger en ekstern samarbejdspartner til at koordinere, sammensætte og gennemføre sparringspaneler for iværksættere under den brede iværksætterindsats. Sparringspanelerne er et frivilligt tilbud til iværksættere, der deltager i eller har deltaget i aktiviteter under den brede iværksætterindsats. Deltagerne kan både være personer uden CVR-nummer og virksomheder, der er etableret inden for de seneste år. Det er desuden muligt for andre relevante iværksættere at deltage efter nærmere aftale. Det er vigtigt at paneler er integreret del af af den samlede indsats. Formålet med panelerne er at give iværksættere adgang til kvalificeret og udviklingsorienteret sparring fra erfarne erhvervsprofiler med relevante kompetencer inden for blandt andet forretningsudvikling, salg, strategi, vækst og finansiering. Der forventes gennemført i alt 27 sparringspaneler i perioden september 2026 til november 2028. Vi søger derfor en samarbejdspartner der kan sikre en professionel, ensartet og værdiskabende afvikling af sparringspaneler på tværs af landet. Den valgte leverandør skal have det samlede ansvar for planlægning, koordinering, rekruttering af panelister, sammensætning af paneler og facilitering af aktiviteterne.

title: Germany – Construction work – TiTra Wärmepumpe VE 06 Anbindung an die Hauptkühlwasserleitung
description: Die Hamburger Energiewerke GmbH (HEnW) haben sich zum Ziel gesetzt, bis 2030 aus der Kohle auszusteigen und bis 2040 eine treibhausgasneutrale Wärmeversorgung für Hamburg zu erreichen. Wesentlicher Baustein ist die Transformation des Kraftwerksstandorts Tiefstack zum Energiepark Tiefstack im Rahmen des Programms TiTra (Tiefstack Transformation). Dem Teilvorhaben 4 (Errichtung einer Flusswasserwärmepumpe, Wärmepumpe Billwerder Bucht) ist das gegenständliche Vorhaben zugeordnet. Ziel ist die Bereitstellung einer thermischen Leistung von mindestens 60 MWth. Zur Förderung des Flusswassers aus der Billwerder Bucht wird das be-stehende Kühlwassersystem des Kraftwerks genutzt. Hierfür ist eine Entnahme- und Einleitleitung an die bestehende Hauptkühlwasserleitung DN 2000 (Spannbeton) anzubinden. Als vorbereitende Maßnahme wird während des planmäßigen Revisionszeitraums des Kraftwerks im Sommer 2027 ein neues Flusswasser-Anbindungsmodul in das Hauptkühlwassersystem einge-bunden. Das Hauptkühlwassersystem DN 2000 wird hierfür im Rahmen der Revision für rund 6 Wo-chen außer Betrieb genommen.

title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Managed Service z/OS
description: Auftraggeber sind die in der Arbeitsgemeinschaft der öffentlich-rechtlichen Rundfunkanstalten der Bundesrepublik Deutschland (ARD) zusammengeschlossenen öffentlich-rechtlichen Landesrundfunkanstalten, das Zweite Deutsche Fernsehen (ZDF) und das Deutschlandradio (DR), vertreten durch die Geschäftsführung des Beitrags-service von ARD, ZDF und Deutschlandradio (nachfolgend "Beitragsservice" oder "Auftraggeber" genannt). Der Beitragsservice beabsichtigt, einen Dienstleistungsvertrag zur Erbringung der Aufgaben im Bereich der z/OS-Systemumgebung für eine Vertragslaufzeit von bis zu drei Jahren abzuschließen. Der Dienstleistungsvertrag kommt mit der Zuschlagserteilung zustande. Zur Vorbereitung der Betriebsübernahme ist eine Transitionsphase vorgesehen, die am 01.02.2027 beginnt. Sie dient der Einarbeitung sowie der Übergabe der Betriebsverantwortung vom bisherigen Auftragnehmer auf den zukünftigen Auftragnehmer. Die Übernahme der Betriebsverantwortung durch den Auftragnehmer hat verbindlich zum 01.07.2027 zu erfolgen. Ab diesem Zeitpunkt sind die vertraglich vereinbarten Dienstleistungen zu erbringen. Der ausgeschriebene Dienstleistungsvertrag hat eine Festlaufzeit von zweieinhalb Jahren, also vom 01.07.2027 bis zum 31.12.2029. Daneben besteht für den Beitragsservice die einmalige Möglichkeit zur Verlängerung des Dienstleistungsvertrags um weitere 6 Monate, also bis zum 30.06.2030. Der Gesamtpreis umfasst sämtliche Leistungen während der Vertragslaufzeit (= Dienstleistungen zu einem pauschalen jährlichen Festpreis sowie die Transitionsphase auf Basis eines Pauschalpreises). Im Rahmen der z/OS Dienstleistungen soll der externe Dienstleister (nachfolgend "Auftragnehmer" genannt) den Betrieb der z/OS Systemumgebungen des Beitragsservice sicherstellen. Die Mainframe Infrastruktur verbleibt am Standort des Bei-tragsservice. Die Aufgaben betreffen die Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen der z/OS Systemprogrammierung, dem Storage Management, der RACF Administration und des z/OS Operating. Der Dienstleister hat das Tagesgeschäft, fortlaufende Aktivitäten sowie periodisch anfallenden Aktivitäten zu erbringen. Die Bearbeitung der Aufgaben wird unter Nutzung der vom Beitragsservice zur Ver-fügung gestellten Anwendungen über einen Remote Zugang und unter Nutzung der technischen Einrichtungen sowie Arbeitsplatzgeräte des Dienstleisters durchgeführt. Der Remote Zugang wird über einen vom Beitragsservice verwalteten Service bereitgestellt. Als Orientierung für die jährlich durchschnittlich anfallenden Aufwände geht der Beitragsservice von einem jährlichen durchschnittlichen Bedarf von bis zu 486 Personentagen (PT) aus. Der Auftragnehmer ist angehalten, basierend auf den Anforderungen der Vergabeunterlagen den Aufwand selbst zu prognostizieren. Hierbei kann die Aufwandsschätzung des Beitragsservices auch über- oder unterschritten werden. Vom Dienstleister ist die Servicezeit von montags bis freitags (außer bundeseinheitliche Feiertage) von 06:30 - 17:00 Uhr sicherzustellen. Der Dienstleister muss innerhalb der Servicezeiten für den Beitragsservice in deutscher Sprache zur Verfügung stehen. Es ist eine direkte Kontaktaufnahme zum Dienstleister zu gewährleisten. Der Einsatz aller zur Umsetzung dieses Vertrages erforderlichen Beschäftigten liegt in der Verantwortung des Dienstleisters. Der Dienstleister hat während der gesamten Vertragslaufzeit sicherzustellen, dass nur entsprechend qualifiziertes Personal für die Leistungserbringung eingesetzt wird. Der Dienstleister stellt durch geeignete technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen sicher, dass die Dienstleistung auch beim Ausfall seiner Mitarbeiter/-innen ohne Ver-zug und uneingeschränkt erbracht wird. Im Verhinderungsfall (zum Beispiel Urlaub, Krankheit) sind Vertreter/-innen mit gleichen Qualifikationen einzusetzen. Eventuell notwendige Einarbeitungsaufwände werden nicht vom Beitragsservice geleistet bzw. vergütet. Die Betriebszeit der z/OS Systeme sowie der angebundenen Systeme zur Datenspeicherung und zur Datensicherung umfasst 7 x 24. Die Betriebsbereitschaft der z/OS Systemumgebung unter Einhaltung der Informationssicherheit ist zu gewährleisten. Der Betrieb der Systeme gliedert sich zeitlich in den Online-Betrieb und den Batch-Betrieb. Der Online-Betrieb ist von montags bis freitags zwischen 06:00 - 19:15 Uhr und an ca. 15 Tagen im Jahr auch samstags zwischen 06:00 - 14:00 Uhr definiert. In der übrigen Zeit findet der Batch-Betrieb statt. Die Reaktionszeiten sind abhängig von der Servicezeit und der Priorität festgelegt. Störungen der Dringlichkeit 1, die innerhalb der Servicezeit gemeldet werden, sind am selben Arbeitstag zu bearbeiten. Definierte Service Anfragen sind innerhalb einer festgelegten Zeit umzusetzen. Weitere Einzelheiten zu den ausgeschriebenen Leistungen sind in den Vergabeunter-lagen (insbesondere Teil B. "Leistungsbeschreibung") enthalten, die die geeigneten Bieter nach Abschluss des Teilnahmewettbewerbs mit der Aufforderung zur Abgabe des Erstangebots erhalten.

title: Switzerland – Tipper trucks – Camion, 3 essieux avec grue et système multibenne
description: Acquisition d'un camion forestier 3 essieux avec grue et système multibenne 1. Objet du marché Le présent appel d'offres porte sur la fourniture, la mise en service et la livraison d'un camion forestier neuf destiné aux activités du Service forestier Zorèyè. Le véhicule sera principalement utilisé pour : * le transport de bois rond et de produits forestiers ; * le transport de plaquettes forestières ; * le transport de bennes, matériaux et équipements ; * les travaux de manutention au moyen d'une grue forestière ; * les interventions sur l'ensemble du territoire des communes desservies par le Service forestier Zorèyè. Le soumissionnaire devra fournir un véhicule entièrement opérationnel, homologué pour circuler sur le réseau routier suisse et conforme à l'ensemble des prescriptions légales en vigueur. 2. Configuration générale souhaitée Le véhicule devra répondre aux caractéristiques minimales suivantes : * camion porteur neuf à trois essieux ; * transmission 6×4 ; * PTAC conforme à la législation suisse ; * cabine adaptée à une utilisation professionnelle intensive ; * châssis compatible avec un équipement multibenne et une grue forestière ; * crochet d'attelage homologué pour remorque ; * charge utile optimisée tout en respectant les charges maximales admissibles sur les essieux. 3. Equipements Le véhicule devra notamment être équipé de : * une grue forestière montée derrière la cabine ; * portée hydraulique d'environ 15 mètres ; * radiocommande complète ; * système multibenne ; * prises hydrauliques et électriques nécessaires à l'exploitation ; * éclairage de travail LED ; * caméra de recul ; * équipement de sécurité conforme aux prescriptions en vigueur. 4. Prestations attendues Le soumissionnaire devra inclure dans son offre : * la fourniture complète du véhicule ; * l'ensemble des adaptations nécessaires ; * les essais de réception ; * la mise en service ; * la formation des utilisateurs ; * la documentation technique en français ; * le carnet d'entretien ; * les certificats d'homologation. 5. Garanties et service après-vente L'offre devra préciser notamment : * les garanties constructeur ; * les garanties sur la chaîne cinématique ; * les garanties sur la grue et les équipements hydrauliques ; * les prestations couvertes ; * les délais d'intervention en cas de panne ; * la disponibilité des pièces de rechange ; * les possibilités de contrat d'entretien ; * les coûts des contrats de maintenance proposés. 6. Délais Le soumissionnaire indiquera : * le délai de fabrication du châssis ; * le délai de montage des équipements ; * la date prévisionnelle de livraison du véhicule prêt à l'emploi. 7. Critères d'évaluation Les offres seront évaluées selon les critères suivants : * prix global de l'offre ; * qualité technique du véhicule ; * adéquation aux besoins du Service forestier ; * coûts d'exploitation et d'entretien ; * garanties proposées ; * qualité du service après-vente ; * délais de livraison ; * valeur résiduelle estimée ; * références du fournisseur. 8. Documents à fournir Chaque offre comprendra notamment : * fiche technique détaillée ; * plans d'implantation des équipements ; * répartition des charges sur les essieux ; * poids à vide et charge utile ; * descriptif complet des équipements ; * consommation et caractéristiques moteur ; * garanties ; * contrat d'entretien (facultatif) ; * planning de livraison. Le pouvoir adjudicateur se réserve le droit de demander tout complément d'information utile à l'analyse des offres.
